title: Run Claude Code with Free AI Models..
description:
You can now use Claude Code...
without paying for expensive Claude subscriptions.
And most people have no idea this is even possible.
Because Claude Code is still one of the most capable AI coding agents available today.
It can read your codebase.
Edit files.
Run terminal commands.
Fix bugs.
And build features across entire projects.
But here's the interesting part...
Developers have built open-source tools that let Claude Code connect to alternative AI models instead.
Which means you're no longer locked into a single provider.
You can use models like DeepSeek, Kimi, Ollama, and other low-cost or free alternatives.
The result?
A much cheaper way to access powerful AI coding workflows.
And honestly...
this is exactly where the industry seems to be heading.
Less dependence on one platform.
More flexibility.
More open ecosystems.
And more people getting access to AI development tools.
.
